title: Polly.Contrib.Simmy
description: Polly.Contrib.Simmy adds chaos testing and fault injection to Polly. It lets you introduce faults like latency, exceptions, or rate limiting into your application to test resilience.

data.text: Polly.Contrib.Simmy is an add-on for Polly that injects faults into your application for chaos testing. You can simulate latency, exceptions, or rate limiting to verify that your resilience policies work as expected.

data.title: Injecting Faults
data.content: Use Simmy to inject exceptions and measure retry behavior.

terms.definition: The practice of injecting failures into a system to test its resilience.
Deliberately introducing errors such as exceptions or latency.
The probability or percentage of calls that receive an injected fault.

data.title: Test Environments Only
data.text: Never enable chaos testing in production unless you have strict guardrails and monitoring in place.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Simmy injects faults into Polly pipelines
It supports exceptions, latency, and rate limiting
Use it to validate retry and fallback behavior in tests
data.takeaway: Simmy lets you prove your resilience policies work before real outages happen.

data.title: Exercise: Simulate Latency
data.description: Add Simmy latency to an operation and verify timeout handling.
steps: Create an operation that calls an external API
Add a Simmy injector that adds 5 seconds of delay
Wrap the call with a Polly timeout of 2 seconds
Run the operation and observe the timeout exception
data.expectedOutcome: The timeout fires because the injected delay exceeds the allowed time.
